info.title: Platform Utilities
info.description: Built-in utility operations handled inside the platform. Unlike ordinary api connections, these operations are not proxied to an upstream base_url; the api gateway dispatches them to an in-process handler. Invoke them with api_invoke_endpoint (inline result) or api_export (result streamed to a portal asset).

post.description: Fetch an arbitrary public URL and return its body. The URL is used exactly as given: no base_url join and no query re-encoding, so presigned download links (S3, GCS, Azure Blob signatures) survive intact. No credentials are injected; headers are opt-in. Destinations on internal address space (loopback, private ranges, link-local and cloud metadata, cluster-internal names) are refused. Use api_invoke_endpoint for small payloads, or api_export with path=/util/fetch to land a large download (an export's signed result file, a generated report) as a portal asset.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to fetch, used byte-for-byte (query string is never re-encoded).

method.description: Read-only methods only. fetch_url never performs writes against the destination.

headers.description: Optional request headers. Nothing is injected by default; presigned URLs carry their credential in the query string and adding an Authorization header would break or leak it. Host, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, and Connection cannot be set.

follow_redirects.description: Follow up to 10 redirects. Every hop is re-checked against the internal-address block.

expected_content_type.description: Optional media type the response must carry (parameters such as charset are ignored). A mismatch fails the call instead of landing mislabeled data.

200.description: The fetched response body, relayed verbatim with the destination's status code and Content-Type. Non-2xx destination statuses are relayed the same way.

400.description: Invalid input (bad URL, unsupported scheme or method, disallowed header).

403.description: Destination refused by the internal-address block.

502.description: The fetch failed (connection error, TLS failure, expected_content_type mismatch).
